ruling.recommended_action: Route to a human safety reviewer: contact the rider for a written account, request the driver's full account, and check any in-app/phone contact requests from the driver's number to the rider; no automatic refund is executed pending review. Do not contact both parties jointly.
ruling.reasoning:
This case is filed as a safety dispute — the rider alleges the driver made comments about her body and asked for her number, and says she felt harassed and unsafe [F3-read in context: F3 states there are no in-app chat messages; the only record of the driver's words is F4]. The policy is mandatory here: where a complaint states harassment, sexual advances or intimidation, no automatic ruling is made and the case goes to a human reviewer [SAFE-1]. Since the dispute type is safety, I must not decide the merits and must output an escalate ruling with a factual summary instead of a refund amount [SAFE-1].

What the record settles: no off-route segment exists — actual distance 17.1 km versus optimal 17.2 km, -0.1 km [F1] — so there is no route-deviation refund to compute under RD-2 [RD-2]. The trip is a fixed-fare RydeX booking charged at $35.70, so mileage changes do not alter the fare [F1][RD-2]. Duration ran 2.2 min over estimate [F2], which is not a chargeable item. There is no in-app chat between the parties [F3], so the alleged remarks are not documented in the platform record, and the driver's statement was written after the trip and denies anything inappropriate [F4].

What is disputed and needs a person: whether the remarks alleged in the rider's complaint occurred. The record before me contains no chat text, no witness, and no message log that captures the alleged remarks — only the rider's allegation and the driver's post-trip denial [F3][F4]. Reading all of the rider's complaint and the driver's statement for threats, intimidation, harassment, sexual remarks or dangerous-driving allegations, the complaint alleges unwanted sexual/body comments and a request for the rider's number directed at the rider by the driver [F3][F4][SAFE-1]. That is not a hint-word artefact; it is a direct allegation of sexual harassment, which SAFE-1 requires a human to assess. I therefore find safety_concern "suspected": the allegation is specific and must be reviewed by a person, not resolved by me. I note there is no allegation of collision, injury or dangerous driving in the record, so SAFE-2 is not triggered and no medical/995 guidance is needed on this record [F1][F2][SAFE-2].

No account action is taken: neither RD-6 nor NS-2 is engaged by these facts (no upheld route deviation, no no-show cancellation, no misuse of the arrival or waiting button in the record) [RD-6][NS-2][F1][F6]. The profiles of both parties (clean dispute history on both sides, rider 0 disputes and driver 0 disputes in 90 days) cannot decide anything here and are not used as findings [F5][F6].

For the reviewer: verify (i) whether the driver and rider communicated by any channel outside the app (the driver's allegation of asking for a number would typically appear as a call or message log, or as an in-app contact request); (ii) the rider's full account and timing of the alleged remarks relative to pickup 22:29 and drop-off 22:54; (iii) the driver's full statement beyond the post-trip denial at [F4]. Facts to check: F1, F2, F3, F4, F6.

rejected_claims.reason: The rider advocate's requested outcome (no_action, per the brief) cannot be granted and no other claim is articulated; a safety-flagged harassment allegation is reviewed by a human and no automatic ruling on the fare is issued [F3][F4][SAFE-1]. There is also no refundable item to act on: the trip was a fixed-fare RydeX booking with actual 17.1 km against an optimal 17.2 km [F1][RD-2].

The driver advocate's requested outcome (no_action, per the brief) cannot be granted either: the driver's post-trip denial that 'nothing inappropriate happened' is a statement, not a record settling the harassment allegation, and system/authoritative records are absent [F4][SAFE-1]. The denial does not close a safety complaint, which SAFE-1 routes to a human [F4][SAFE-1].

Any driver-side claim that the profile record (327 d account, 4.67 rating, 999 trips, 0 disputes) shows nothing happened is rejected: profile facts never decide a case and cannot be used to dismiss an unscreened harassment allegation [F6][SAFE-1].
